+def _fill_missing_variables(datasets, fill_value):
+    """
+    Fill in missing variables in datasets with NaN values.
+    
+    This allows concatenating datasets with different variables by filling
+    missing variables with NaN, similar to pandas.concat with outer join.
+    
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    datasets : list of Dataset
+        Datasets to fill missing variables in. Modified in-place.
+    fill_value : scalar
+        Value to use for filling missing variables
+    """
+    # Collect all variables that appear in any dataset
+    all_vars = set()
+    for ds in datasets:
+        all_vars.update(ds.variables)
+    
+    # For each dataset, fill in missing variables
+    for ds in datasets:
+        missing_vars = all_vars - set(ds.variables)
+        for var_name in missing_vars:
+            # Find a dataset that has this variable to get its metadata
+            for other_ds in datasets:
+                if var_name in other_ds.variables:
+                    other_var = other_ds.variables[var_name]
+                    # Create a NaN-filled variable with the same dims and dtype
+                    fill_shape = tuple(ds.dims.get(d, 1) for d in other_var.dims)
+                    filled_data = np.full(fill_shape, fill_value, dtype=other_var.dtype)
+                    ds.variables[var_name] = Variable(
+                        other_var.dims, filled_data, other_var.attrs
+                    )
+                    break
+
